::: {#exm-deviance-drop}

#### The likelihood ratio statistic of the treatment effect

In the six-patient trial, $q = 1$.

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# drop in deviance, the likelihood ratio statistic
wf_g2 <- wf_fit$null.deviance - deviance(wf_fit)
wf_g2
```

The statistic is $`r round(wf_g2, 3)`$.

:::
